items.exampleEn: Do you know how to operate this camera?
items.exampleZh: 你知道怎麼操作這台相機嗎？

items.exampleEn: Only one tree survived the storm.
items.exampleZh: 只有一棵樹撐過了那場暴風雨。

items.exampleEn: A crowd gathered around the street singer.
items.exampleZh: 一群人聚集在街頭歌手身邊。

items.exampleEn: The spread of phones changed our lives.
items.exampleZh: 手機的普及改變了我們的生活。

items.exampleEn: The kids ran away from the waves.

items.exampleZh: 這場雨毀了我們的野餐。

items.exampleEn: There is a burn on the old wooden table.
items.exampleZh: 那張舊木桌上有一塊燒焦的痕跡。

items.sentenceEn: Look both ways before you cross the street.
items.sentenceZh: 過馬路前要先看左右兩邊。

items.audioEn: We sat on the beach and watched the waves.
items.audioZh: 我們坐在海灘上看海浪。

items.sentenceEn: My dog destroyed my new shoes.
items.sentenceZh: 我的狗把我的新鞋咬壞了。

items.sentenceEn: Only a few people can operate this old machine.
items.sentenceZh: 只有少數人會操作這台舊機器。

items.stemEn: Every year, my whole family ____ at Grandma's house for New Year.
items.stemZh: 每年過年，我們全家都會在奶奶家團聚。

items.stemEn: I got a small ____ on my hand from the hot pan.
items.stemZh: 我的手被熱鍋燙出一個小傷。

items.passageEn: Last weekend, my family went camping by a lake. We crossed the lake in a small boat to a quiet beach. The waves were small. We gathered wood and made a fire, and Dad put water around it to stop the spread of the fire. Then Mom cooked a big dinner. I got a small burn from the hot pan, but I was fine. That night, a strong wind destroyed our camping chairs. "We survived!" Dad said in the morning.
items.passageZh: 上週末，我們全家去湖邊露營。我們坐小船渡湖，到了一處安靜的沙灘。浪很小。我們撿木柴生了火，爸爸在火堆周圍灑了水，防止火勢蔓延。接著媽媽煮了一頓豐盛的晚餐。我被熱鍋燙了一下，不過沒事。那天晚上，一陣強風把我們的露營椅吹壞了。早上爸爸說：「我們活下來了！」

questions.questionZh: 他們怎麼到那處安靜的沙灘？
那天晚上發生了什麼事？

referenceEn: This machine is easy to operate.
It is easy to operate this machine.
rubricZh: 可寫例如 easy to operate

items.instructionZh: 用 survive 造一個句子，說說某種動物或植物怎麼活下來。
referenceEn: Some plants can survive the cold winter.
Fish can't survive out of water.
rubricZh: survive 可直接接名詞（例如 survive the winter）或單獨使用
can／can't＋原形動詞（例如 can survive）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關疑似 S11：閱讀的「一桌菜」是另一個詞義，拿掉；改在閱讀用「火勢蔓延」
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "傳播；普及；蔓延"（原 "傳播；普及；（一桌）菜餚"）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 第②關：疑似：spread 在 A2 常用義是動詞（散布、塗抹、蔓延），本課單字卡用名詞 The spread of phones，閱讀又用 a big spread of food（一桌菜，口語、較高級用法），請依 CEFR-J 該級詞性確認。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 執行長裁示：教課綱該級列的詞性。spread 名詞 A2、動詞 B2，維持名詞；閱讀改用名詞「蔓延」義（stop the spread of the fire），拿掉「一桌菜」

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第②關：疑似：burn 在 A2 常用義為動詞「燃燒；燙傷」，本課單字卡、mcq（q14）與閱讀皆用名詞「燙傷處」，請依 CEFR-J 該級詞性確認。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "There is a burn on the old wooden table."（原 "He has a burn on his arm from cooking."）；burn 名詞 A2（執行長裁示照名詞教）；第③關：單字卡和 mcq、閱讀同樣是下廚燙傷，改成桌上的燒痕

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：配合例句修改
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "那張舊木桌上有一塊燒焦的痕跡。"（原 "他做菜時手臂被燙傷了一塊。"）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：配合例句修改
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "燒傷；燙傷；燒痕"（原 "燒傷；燙傷"）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關疑似 S6：destroys 一定要接受詞，可靠文法刪去；換成不及物、語意不通的 disappears
執行長第②③關裁示修正：配合干擾項 destroys→disappears
執行長第②③關裁示修正：第②關：Dad operated a small boat 搭配不自然，開船應說 drove / steered / rowed a small boat；operate 多用於機器、設備。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "Last weekend, my family went camping by a lake. We crossed the lake in a small boat to a quiet beach. The waves were small. We gathered wood and made a fire, and Dad put water around it to stop the spread of the fire. Then Mom cooked a big dinner. I got a small burn from the hot pan, but I was fine. That night, a strong wind destroyed our camping chairs. \"We survived!\" Dad said in the morning."（原 "Last weekend, my family went camping by a lake. Dad operated a small boat, and we crossed the lake to a quiet beach. The waves were small. We gathered wood and made a fire, and Mom put out a big spread of food. I got a small burn from the hot pan, but I was fine. That night, a strong wind destroyed our camping chairs. \"We survived!\" Dad said in the morning."）；operate 另有單字卡、跟讀、翻譯；spread 改用「火勢蔓延」義
